summary: As a physics student passionate about astronomy and astrophysics, I have published two peer-reviewed papers and won five international awards in competitions. My research experience spans gravitational waves, black hole physics, and gamma-ray bursts.

projects.title: Research Assistant, Max Planck Institute for Gravitational Physics (Albert Einstein Institute)
projects.summary: Developed a normalizing flow-based neural network model to optimize O4a continuous gravitational wave search strategies by predicting mismatch distributions between signals and search templates. The project addressed computational bottlenecks limiting detection sensitivity, focusing on parameter optimization for coherent integration time, template grid spacings, and refinement factors.
highlights: Achieved mean absolute error of 1% for directed searches and 0.8% for all-sky searches
Paper submitted to Physical Review D (under review).

projects.title: Project Leader, National College Student Innovation Project, Sichuan University, China
projects.summary: Developed a black hole detection and parameter estimation model using simulated observations from space telescopes. The project involved black hole accretion disk simulation, telescope simulation, data processing, an ensemble deep learning model for both black hole detection and recognition, and final validation with the data from Hubble Space Telescope.
highlights: Publication on Physical Review D as first author
